operations.summary: patch a production norm (update header, upsert/delete children by rec_id)
operations.description: Updates an existing production norm. Header fields are updated if provided. Child rows (raw_products, costs) support three operations based on `rec_id` and `delete` fields: - **Update**: `rec_id` is set, `delete` is absent/false — updates the existing row - **Delete**: `rec_id` is set, `delete` is `true` — deletes the row - **Insert**: `rec_id` is absent — inserts a new row Example: ```json { "id": 123, "raw_products": [ { "rec_id": 456, "delete": true }, { "rec_id": 789, "product_id": 10, "formula_brutto": "updated" }, { "product_id": 15, "formula_brutto": "new row" } ] } ```
